messages.content: Help me ensure that the signs of the BigDecimal elements in the array `durations` are aligned from index 2 to index 5, considering that the elements represent different units of time in a duration object?

function.name: DurationImpl_alignSigns

buf.description: The array of BigDecimal elements representing different units of time whose signs need to be aligned. This is Java Array type parameter in string representation. The list elements are of type any; they are not in string representation.

start.description: The starting index of the subarray to align signs. This is Java integer type parameter in string representation.

end.description: The ending index of the subarray to align signs. This is Java integer type parameter in string representation.
